title: Museum pass was great but...
text: Museum pass was great but make sure you check times - most museums in Barcelona are CLOSED on Mondays.  Also, you will need to go to Playa Catalunya to redeem the receipt. That's an extra cost.
author: Ronald_P

title: We definitely wanted to...
text: We definitely wanted to see the Picasso Museum but it was sold out on the day we had available in Barcelona. The pass did the trick and got us in.
author: Gerardo_L

title: Great way to explore Barcelona
text: The MACBA can exchange the tickets for the passport. Nice way to explore the city and see some truly interesting art and culture.
author: Bree_L

title: Barcelona mola 😉
text: Excellent option: you just need to go to MACBA and validate your access. Passport valid for one year !!! And very affordable price.
author: TANIA_R

title: PIcasso
text: We visited Picasso museum and didn't want to leave. So many artworks and we definitely want to go back. Also visited CCCB and it was cool
author: Ayanna_R

title: Museum passport
text: I’m so glad I did this museum pass, it was not expensive and it’s good for a year from the time it was first used.  I frequent Europe each year so I will return again to see more art museums here in Barcelona.  The really cool part was that I didn’t have to wait in any lines and I saw lots of great art in this incredible city.
author: Judy_C

title: AMAZING
text: The tour was informative and thorough. Our tour guide was knowledgeable, professional, and friendly. This tour was well worth the cost!
author: Dreamer736801

title: Great!
text: I think the pass was really great, I’m not someone who would normally visit lots of art galleries... maybe the odd one or two here and there, but it’s given me the motivation to fill out the little passport docket you get haha! But I actually learnt so much more about art and Barcelona through the medium, got to explore more of the city to get to the museums, and got some great souvenirs from the shops, but on top of that, I got inspired! So lovely to stroll around. I am definitely glad that I bought the pass. You save lots of money. Definitely recommend. Plus the pass is valid for a year, but
author: The F
